name: Fleet car
description: A sleek white autonomous electric car from OpenBrain's fleet, black glass roof, lidar dome, light bars front and back.

made_with.settings: multi-image (main and side views), textured, PBR

notes: Prepared with tools/prep_prop.py. 4.61 m long. Full resolution, 901,904 triangles: collapsing to 40,000 made the panels rough (Bryson, 2026-10-11). --glow 2: the red tail light glows. tools/build_fixtures.py adds the OpenBrain emblem to both doors as decals, from the prepared model kept in sources. Lowered 2026-10-11 (Bryson): Meshy remesh to 59973 triangles, textures shrunk to 2K with prep_prop.py --max-texture 2048; looks the same, loads far faster.
